text_block_list.text:
The legendary kitchen knife has finally been restored.
Today is its—grand unveiling!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: To everyone who always watches my videos! Thanks for coming out to the event today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And... this is it!
The "Legendary Kitchen Knife"~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so this is it...!
Amazing! I can't wait to try the food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me~! Okay then, Trainer, lend me a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, it's minestrone~!
Be sure to enjoy all the hearty ingredients packed inside~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, looks so delicious~!
The garlic smell is really whetting my appetite~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, this is the dish I served to the guardian
who was protecting the kitchen knife~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
G-Guardian of the Kitchen Knife...!?
I don't really get it, but it sounds amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They were really nice~! Although they were pretty shocked that the kitchen knife came loose~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Make lots of delicious food!"
Man, I'm super fired up for today too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~!
This time, it's mushroom takikomi rice onigiri and tonjiru!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Looks so good...! Ah, does this dish
happen to have a story behind it as well?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! When we were looking for the whetstone...
and said 'Let's give it one more push~', those were the rice balls we all ate together!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: A taste full of memories shared with friends, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
*munch, chew*! Mmm~!
I bet this saltiness really hit the spot after working up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whew~! Every single dish was delicious!!
I'm stuffed and completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Bono-chan, thank you so much for the delicious food... and for sharing all those wonderful stories!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad everyone was able to eat their fill.

After the event, while cleaning up with Hishi Akebono,
she quietly spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
! Ehehe, yeah.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I feel like I was able to share my treasure with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Something surely far more important
than a dish made with a legendary knife.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Good tools really do matter.
They affect the taste, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you know... I realized that wasn't why
everyone was so happy. ...Because—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cooking can carry memories too!
It can satisfy both your stomach and your heart even more...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to share even more!
Both the food and the story behind it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So... alright? Trainer.

—Ehh!? A mythical ingredient, you say?!
—Idiot! Keep your voice down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go!
On our next adventure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's make lots more memories... and deliver them to everyone!

In search of an even fuller stomach...
The adventure continued.
